title: Fire Alarm & Evacuation Alert (PHF)
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Fire alarm cables on their own supports using metal clips?
Devices fitted and labelled, heads covered during dusty works?
Fire alarm supply on its own labelled "FIRE ALARM – DO NOT SWITCH OFF" spur, dated?
Cables terminated in all control and ancillary equipment?
Detectors at least 500 mm from walls, beams and obstructions?
Ask the fitter: What clips are you fixing the fire alarm cable with? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Cause and effect tested with smoke control and lifts?
Detectors within 600 mm (smoke) / 150 mm (heat) of the ceiling – not dropped too low?
No detectors next to air inlets/fans or light fittings; no rooms missing a detector?
Call points at exits/stair doors and not wrongly positioned?
Sounders positioned as the layout, all the same tone?
Panel cabling neat, mains supply and aux connections labelled, batteries dated?
questions.source: PHF fire alarm ITP – panel checklist 25.2–25.4

questions.q: Aspirating pipework clipped at least every 1.2 m, sampling holes clear?
questions.source: PHF fire alarm ITP – ASD checklist

notOk.t: Sounder / detector face plates missing or not flush
Fire alarm cables on plastic ties or other containment – metal clips direct
Cables pulled down / kinked at bends
Detectors not fitted (base as a minimum)
ID labels missing on hot boxes and spurs
